# FFT periods

Fast Fourier Transform (FFT): periods for a real signal of length t (in
time) with n samples.

## Usage

``` r
fft_period(f)
```

## Arguments

- f:

  num. The harmonics frequencies.

## Value

\\p\\ the harmonics periods, \\p=1/f\\.

## Examples

``` r
fft_freq(201, 10) %>%
  fft_period()
```
